data.gender_notes: Jayla is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Jayla is derived from the Hebrew word 'yael', which means 'mountain goat' or 'gazelle'. In the Bible, Yael is the name of a warrior woman who saved Israel by killing the Canaanite king Sisera. Jayla's meaning can be interpreted as 'joyful one' or 'shining light'. The name Jayla carries the meaning “Joy, radiance, or gentle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jayla usually hope their child will grow to embody joy, radiance, or gentle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Jayla represents the gentle strength and resilience of a mountain goat. It symbolizes the inner power and determination to overcome challenges and bring joy to those around you.

historical_references.reference: The name Jayla is believed to have originated from the Hebrew name 'Jael'. Jael was a heroine from the Old Testament who saved Israel by killing Sisera, the captain of the Canaanite army, with a tent peg while he slept. This name was in use during the time of the Israelite monarchy (11th-6th centuries BCE).

During the Middle Ages, the name Jayla became associated with the Virgin Mary due to the similarity of the name to 'Jael' and 'Gael', which were believed to be variations of the name 'Mary'. The name Jayla was used as a Marian name in various European countries such as France and Spain.

TikTok, the short-form video app, has become a space for Jaylas to showcase their dance skills and lip-syncing abilities, often using hashtags like #JaylaDanceChallenge to connect with other users. Lastly, on YouTube, Jaylas can be found sharing their personal journeys and experiences, from fashion and beauty tutorials to inspirational talks and vlogs, demonstrating the name's association with empowerment and self-expression.
